T-2374: the Agency House's two grounded apertures are holes again, not striped ladders (#1690)

* T-2374: the Agency House's front aperture count, from its own picture

The Wau-Bun panorama of 1831 draws Cobweb Castle's front gable with TWO upright
dark marks standing on the ground and ONE small mark above them. The log_dwelling
compound path states ONE opening per room, so that front was not sayable in data
at all, and every data-only trial was correctly refused by the archetype's own
validation; splitting the centre room to get a second opening would change the
roof and the walls the rest of the record states.

`compound_apertures` is the opt-in that says it: an explicit set on ONE room's
outward face, which OVERRIDES that room's singular `front_opening` so the old
centred door cannot survive among the new marks as a phantom — in the mesh or in
the front-wall reading the entrance, apron and signboard generators share. It is
bounded: inside the wall or under the room's own roof rake, clear of its
neighbours, at most one stated way in, refused on the bounded elbow and on a
record with no stated rooms, and absent by default everywhere else.

What the picture gives is the COUNT and roughly the arrangement along the face.
Every coordinate is set out from this record's own 5 m centre wall and its own
rake; the recess section is this archetype's existing opening kit; and the entry
role on the right-hand mark is a design inference, not a reading — it goes there
because that is where the old centre door stood, so the town's one grounded
entrance on that front stays one entrance. No glazing, closure, leaf, shutter,
interior, attic room, white paint or historic function is claimed, and the white
of the engraving's paper is not evidence of paint. L-cobweb-apertures-2374
records all of it.

Built and qualified on the pinned, sha256-verified Blender 4.5.3 on Ubuntu 26.04
in four bounded batches: all 82 log_dwelling masters regenerated, and 81 came out
BYTE-IDENTICAL, which is the measurement that the option is genuinely off for
every other record. Cobweb's master moved
af1f33c0f5d75fc8c40e6cbb589adfd7d29d551572c2775e236bb260f6ee561f (139,824 B) ->
4f42207be5fcb2391fda58672ce8442b02aba9510f3096db8c2934b695fe7bea (139,248 B)
and its web derivative
49cfcb869c0a39bd936c2c22428179538c37c5a380b9f27c53fab019719b8dcd (31,804 B) ->
1699d7aa1c4b0abb6229bd4cbfaed95013f3ede9323f4945396583fd14b26e23 (30,304 B).
No other archetype family, structure version or foreign registry row is touched.

Not a match. The panorama's camera remains UNSOLVED and is not enrolled in
data/reference_views/; the compound's overall width, the wing and sub-roof
silhouettes, the roof junctions and valleys, the text-attested partial
clapboarding and the finish and tone all still differ from the picture; the
source is retrospective 1831 context printed in 1881 and is not proof of the
building as it stood on 1835-07-01. T-2374's image gate stays open.

Gate: tools/check.sh --part 1/4 .. 4/4, all four green (1,150 steps, none red).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* T-2374: the Agency House's two grounded apertures are holes again, not striped ladders

The first cut of `compound_apertures` put its dark face 0.004 m out from the wall
PLANE, because it passed the bare `APERTURE_BACK_M` to `openings.face`. But
`openings.surround` reads its `back` from the wall's SKIN and ran the reveal to
0.026 m, and a log wall's courses stand 0.022 m proud. So the face sat BEHIND the
logs and both grounded apertures were crossed by horizontal courses — they read as
striped ladders rather than holes. An independent fixed-camera review of the
committed meshes found it; every numeric check, both smoke legs and the application
review had passed, because the fault lived in a depth no reading looks at.

The face is now given `w.skin + APERTURE_BACK_M`, the same absolute offset the
surround's own reveal runs back to. That is the convention `_opening`'s blind
doorway already follows in this file (`back = -0.30 - w.skin` beside
`face(..., -0.30, ...)`), and it is what `APERTURE_BACK_M`'s own comment says the
constant is for: the dark face, just proud of the logs' own relief.

`tools/test_log_compound_apertures.py` now pins the invariant by reading the
builder's source — the surround's `back` and the face's offset must be the same
absolute offset, and that offset must exceed `RELIEF_M`. Reverting the one
expression makes it fail; the guard was checked against the defect both ways.

No shared helper, schema, recipe scheme, camera, grade or match verdict is touched,
and no other record states a set. Rebuilt on pinned sha-verified Blender 4.5.3 on
Ubuntu 26.04.1: all 82 log_dwelling masters in four bounded batches, 81 of them
byte-identical. Cobweb's MASTER 4f42207b -> 1ddf548d, WEB 1699d7aa -> 99997b5f.

T-2374 stays OPEN/PARTIAL: the panorama's camera is still UNSOLVED and unenrolled,
and the compound's width, wings, sub-roofs, roof junctions, partial clapboarding,
finish and tone all still differ from the picture.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""T-2374: the explicit compound aperture set — bounded, opt-in, and off everywhere else.
+
+The Wau-Bun panorama of 1831 draws the Agency House's front gable with TWO upright
+dark marks standing on the ground and ONE small mark above them. The log_dwelling
+compound path states one opening per room, so that front was not sayable at all, and
+nothing short of splitting the centre room — which would change the roof and the walls
+the rest of the record states — could say it in data alone. `compound_apertures` is the
+opt-in that lets ONE room state its own set instead.
+
+An opt-in is only as good as what refuses it, so this holds four things, none of them
+needing Blender:
+
+  1. the params module's gable geometry tracks the BUILDER'S own overhang — the gable a
+     compound room closes stands `COMPOUND_ROOF_OVERHANG_M` outboard of its roof
+     rectangle because `log_dwelling._compound` passes no overhang to
+     `MeshBuilder.add_gable_roof`, so the default is read out of mesh.py's source (it
+     imports bpy) and compared. An aperture measured against the wrong triangle is
+     buried in the roof or hanging off the rake, and nothing else here would notice;
+  2. Cobweb Castle resolves to the three stated apertures, its centre room's own
+     `front_opening` is OVERRIDDEN rather than drawn as well — no phantom centre door —
+     and exactly one of the three is a grounded way in, so the entrance reader still
+     finds one door on that front;
+  3. the front WALL reading and the builder's rectangles are the same rectangles, and
+     the gable one is NOT on the front wall (it stands above the wall head, outboard of
+     it, where no signboard, apron or doorway reads);
+  4. the dark face the builder draws stands PROUD OF THE LOG RELIEF, at the same
+     offset the surround's own reveal runs back to. The first cut of this passed the
+     bare `APERTURE_BACK_M` to `openings.face`, which measures from the wall PLANE,
+     while `openings.surround` reads its `back` from the wall's SKIN — so the face
+     landed 0.004 m out where the logs bulge 0.022 m, and the courses ran across both
+     grounded apertures as stripes. Every numeric check in this file passed anyway,
+     because the fault was in a depth no reading looks at. Read off the source, so it
+     needs no Blender;
+  5. every malformed set is refused, one case per rule, and every other log_dwelling
+     record in the tree resolves with an empty set and the front rects the legacy rule
+     has always given it.
+
+Run `--self-test` for the refusals alone; with no argument it runs the lot.
+"""

+import argparse
+import ast
+import copy
+import json

+                if arg.arg == "overhang" and isinstance(default, ast.Constant):
+                    return default.value
+    return None
+
+
+def module_constant(module: Path, name: str) -> float | None:
+    """A module-level float constant, read from source rather than imported."""
+    tree = ast.parse(module.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    for node in tree.body:
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
+            for target in node.targets:
+                if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == name \
+                        and isinstance(node.value, ast.Constant):
+                    return node.value.value
+    return None
+
+
+def aperture_face_offset() -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """What `_compound_aperture` passes as the dark face's offset, and as the
+    surround's `back`, each rendered back to source text."""
+    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / "generators" / "archetypes" / "log_dwelling.py")
+                     .read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    face = back = ""
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not (isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_compound_aperture"):
+            continue
+        for call in (n for n in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)):
+            target = ast.unparse(call.func)
+            if target == "openings.face" and len(call.args) >= 3:
+                face = ast.unparse(call.args[2])
+            elif target == "openings.surround":
+                for kw in call.keywords:
+                    if kw.arg == "back":
+                        back = ast.unparse(kw.value)
+    return face, back
+
+
+def record(structure_id: str) -> dict:
+    return json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "structures" / f"{structure_id}.json")
+                      .read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def resolve(rec: dict):
+    return ldp.from_phase(rec["phases"][0], rec)
+
+
+def refuses(rec: dict, apertures, why: str) -> None:
+    """A record whose stated set is `apertures` must not resolve."""
+    bad = copy.deepcopy(rec)
+    form = bad["phases"][0]["form"]
+    form["compound_apertures"] = {"value": apertures, "confidence": "reconstructed"}
+    try:
+        resolve(bad)
+    except ldp.ParamError as exc:
+        check(True, f"refused: {why} ({exc})")
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
+        check(False, f"refused: {why} — but with {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+    else:
+        check(False, f"NOT refused: {why}")
+
+
+def ap(**kw) -> dict:
+    out = {"room": 0, "face": "+y", "zone": "wall", "kind": "aperture",
+           "u0": 4.26, "u1": 5.16, "z0": 0.02, "z1": 1.95}
+    out.update(kw)
+    return out
+
+
+def run_refusals(rec: dict) -> None:
+    good = ap()
+    refuses(rec, [ap(room=9)], "a room the record does not state")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(room=True)], "a boolean room index")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(room=1)], "a room whose +y wall is not an outward face")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(face="-y")], "an unsupported face")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(zone="roof")], "an unsupported zone")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(kind="window")], "an unsupported kind")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(u0=float("inf"))], "a non-finite coordinate")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(z0=True)], "a boolean coordinate")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(u0=5.16, u1=4.26)], "a negative width")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(z0=1.95, z1=0.02)], "a negative height")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(u0=3.9, u1=4.9)], "a wall aperture past its room's corner")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(u0=8.2, u1=8.95)], "a wall aperture inside the corner margin")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(z1=2.55)], "a wall aperture into the wall head")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(zone="gable", z0=2.2, z1=2.9)], "a gable aperture reaching below the eave")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(zone="gable", u0=5.57, u1=6.27, z0=3.9, z1=4.5)],
+            "a gable aperture standing through its own rake")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(zone="gable", u0=3.8, u1=4.5, z0=2.7, z1=3.3)],
+            "a gable aperture off the end of the rake")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(kind="door", z0=0.9, z1=2.1)], "a way in that does not reach the ground")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(kind="door", zone="gable", u0=5.57, u1=6.27, z0=2.74, z1=3.54)],
+            "a way in up in the gable")
+    refuses(rec, [ap(kind="door"), ap(kind="door", u0=6.22, u1=7.12)], "two ways in")
+    refuses(rec, [good, ap(u0=5.2, u1=6.1)], "two apertures with no wall between them")
+    refuses(rec, [good, ap(u0=4.8, u1=5.6)], "two apertures that overlap")
+    refuses(rec, [], "an empty stated set")
+    refuses(rec, [ap() for _ in range(7)], "more apertures than the bound allows")
+    refuses(rec, [{"room": 0, "zone": "wall", "kind": "aperture",
+                   "u0": 4.26, "u1": 5.16, "z0": 0.02, "z1": 1.95}],
+            "an aperture missing a key")
+
+    # ...and the two shapes of record that may not carry a set at all.
+    elbow = record("wolf_point_tavern")
+    elbow["phases"][0]["form"]["compound_apertures"] = {
+        "value": [ap()], "confidence": "reconstructed"}
+    try:
+        resolve(elbow)
+    except ldp.ParamError as exc:
+        check(True, f"refused: a set on the bounded elbow ({exc})")
+    else:
+        check(False, "NOT refused: a set on the bounded elbow")
+
+    plain = record("walker_meeting_house")
+    plain["phases"][0]["form"]["compound_apertures"] = {
+        "value": [ap()], "confidence": "reconstructed"}
+    try:
+        resolve(plain)
+    except ldp.ParamError as exc:
+        check(True, f"refused: a set on a house with no stated rooms ({exc})")
+    else:
+        check(False, "NOT refused: a set on a house with no stated rooms")

+def run_reading(rec: dict) -> None:
+    oh = gable_roof_default_overhang()
+    check(oh == ldp.COMPOUND_ROOF_OVERHANG_M,
+          f"COMPOUND_ROOF_OVERHANG_M {ldp.COMPOUND_ROOF_OVERHANG_M} is "
+          f"add_gable_roof's own default overhang {oh}")
+
+    p = resolve(rec)
+    check(len(p.compound_apertures) == 3,
+          f"Cobweb Castle states three apertures ({len(p.compound_apertures)})")
+    plane, g0, g1, apex, eave, ridge = ldp.compound_gable_face(p, 0)
+    wall = p.compound_parts[0][0]
+    check(abs(plane - (wall[3] + ldp.COMPOUND_ROOF_OVERHANG_M)) < 1e-9,
+          f"its centre gable stands at y {plane} — the wall at {wall[3]} plus the overhang")
+    check(abs(eave - p.wall_height_m) < 1e-9 and ridge > eave,
+          f"that gable runs from the eave {eave} up to the ridge {ridge:.3f}")
+
+    rects = ldp.compound_front_rects(p)
+    centre = [r for r in rects if r[0] == wall[3]]
+    check(len(centre) == 2,
+          f"the centre room's front carries the two stated wall apertures ({len(centre)})")
+    old_u = (wall[0] + wall[2]) / 2.0
+    check(not any(abs((r[2] + r[3]) / 2.0 - old_u) < 1e-9 and r[1] == "door" for r in centre),
+          "the room's own front_opening is overridden, not drawn as well — no phantom centre door")
+    check(sorted(r[1] for r in centre) == ["aperture", "door"],
+          "...and what stands there is one neutral aperture and one stated way in")
+
+    wings = [r for r in rects if r[0] != wall[3]]
+    check(len(wings) == 2 and all(r[1] == "window" for r in wings),
+          f"both wings keep their own single window ({[r[1] for r in wings]})")
+
+    w = ldp.front_wall(p)
+    kinds = sorted(o["kind"] for o in w["openings"])
+    check(kinds == ["aperture", "door"],
+          f"the front wall reads exactly those two rectangles ({kinds})")
+    check(all(o["z1"] <= w["wall_height_m"] + 1e-9 for o in w["openings"]),
+          "nothing on the front WALL reading stands above the wall head")
+    doors = [o for o in w["openings"] if o["kind"] == "door" and o["z0"] < 0.30]
+    check(len(doors) == 1,
+          f"the entrance reader finds exactly one grounded way in ({len(doors)})")
+    check("aperture" in facade_openings.HOLE_KINDS and
+          "aperture" not in ("door", "shop_door", "open_bay"),
+          "an aperture is a hole a board must clear, and not an entrance kind")
+
+    stated = ldp.compound_aperture_rects(p)
+    walls = {(pl, k, a, c, z0, z1) for pl, zone, k, a, c, z0, z1 in stated if zone == "wall"}
+    check(walls <= set(rects),
+          "the builder's wall apertures are the SAME rectangles the facade reader gives")
+    gables = [s for s in stated if s[1] == "gable"]
+    check(len(gables) == 1 and abs(gables[0][0] - plane) < 1e-9,
+          "the one gable aperture is reported on the gable plane, not on the wall")
+    check(not any(abs(r[0] - plane) < 1e-9 for r in rects),
+          "...and never reaches the front-wall reading")
+
+    run_face_depth()
+

+def run_face_depth() -> None:
+    """The dark face stands clear of the logs, and with the surround's own reveal.
+
+    `openings.face(b, w, n, ...)` puts its rectangle `n` out from the wall's PLANE;
+    `openings.surround(..., back=k)` runs its reveal back to `w.skin + k`. So the
+    builder has to hand the face `w.skin + APERTURE_BACK_M` for the two to meet,
+    and if it hands over the bare constant the face sits BEHIND the log relief and
+    the courses stripe it. That is a geometry fault no count or rectangle reading
+    in this file can see, so it is pinned here on the source itself.
+    """
+    gen = ROOT / "generators"
+    back_m = module_constant(gen / "archetypes" / "log_dwelling.py", "APERTURE_BACK_M")
+    relief_m = module_constant(gen / "common" / "logwork.py", "RELIEF_M")
+    check(isinstance(back_m, float) and isinstance(relief_m, float) and back_m > 0
+          and relief_m > 0,
+          f"APERTURE_BACK_M {back_m} and RELIEF_M {relief_m} both read off source")
+
+    face, back = aperture_face_offset()
+    check(back == "APERTURE_BACK_M",
+          f"the surround's reveal runs back to the wall skin plus APERTURE_BACK_M ({back})")
+    check(face == "w.skin + APERTURE_BACK_M",
+          f"and the dark face is given that same absolute offset ({face})")
+    if isinstance(back_m, float) and isinstance(relief_m, float):
+        check(relief_m + back_m > relief_m,
+              f"so the face lands at {relief_m + back_m:.3f} m, proud of the "
+              f"{relief_m:.3f} m the log courses stand out — not behind them")
+
+
+def run_default_off() -> None:
+    """Every other log_dwelling record states no set and keeps its legacy front."""
+    changed, seen = [], 0
+    for path in sorted((ROOT / "data" / "structures").glob("*.json")):
+        rec = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        if rec.get("archetype") != "log_dwelling" or rec["id"] == "cobweb_castle":
+            continue
+        for phase in rec.get("phases", []):
+            if not phase.get("form"):
+                continue
+            p = ldp.from_phase(phase, rec)
+            seen += 1
+            if p.compound_apertures:
+                changed.append(f"{rec['id']}/{phase.get('id')}")
+            if p.compound_parts and p.compound_joint is None:
+                legacy = [r for r in ldp.compound_front_rects(p)]
+                if any(r[1] not in ("door", "window") for r in legacy):
+                    changed.append(f"{rec['id']}/{phase.get('id')} front kinds")
+    check(not changed and seen > 0,
+          f"{seen} other log_dwelling phases resolve with no stated set and their legacy "
+          f"fronts ({', '.join(changed) if changed else 'none changed'})")
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap_ = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap_.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true",
+                     help="only the refusals — the gates proved by breaking them")
+    args = ap_.parse_args()
+    rec = record("cobweb_castle")
+    if args.self_test:
+        run_refusals(rec)
+    else:
+        run_reading(rec)
+        run_default_off()
+        run_refusals(rec)
+    if FAILS:
+        print(f"\n{len(FAILS)} failure(s)")
+        return 1
+    print("\nall checks passed")
+    return 0

+if __name__ == "__main__":
